learningObjective: Distinguish instruction-level, data-level and thread-level parallelism, and identify architectural mechanisms exposing each form.
stem: Which of the following statements correctly connect a parallelism level (ILP / DLP / TLP) to an architectural mechanism? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: ILP (instruction-level parallelism) is exposed by out-of-order execution, register renaming, and superscalar issue: independent instructions overlap in the pipeline of one core.
DLP (data-level parallelism) is exposed by SIMD/SIMT execution: the same operation is applied across many data elements simultaneously by vector lanes or warp threads.
TLP (thread-level parallelism) is exposed by multi-core CPUs, SMT/hyperthreading, and GPU warps: multiple independent control streams run in parallel.
ILP, DLP and TLP are mutually exclusive: a program can exhibit only one of the three at a time, so architectures must choose which one to exploit at compile time.

explanation: A: OoO cores exploit independent instructions in a single thread's dynamic stream. B: SIMD lanes and SIMT warps apply the same operation across elements. C: multi-core CPUs, SMT (e.g., Intel HT), and GPU warp-level parallelism are all TLP mechanisms. D is false: modern systems routinely combine all three (e.g., a GPU: SIMT DLP within warp + TLP across warps/blocks + ILP within each thread via pipeline).

optionExplanations.A: Correct: ILP mechanisms include OoO, renaming, superscalar issue.
optionExplanations.B: Correct: SIMD lanes and SIMT warps are canonical DLP.
optionExplanations.C: Correct: multi-core, SMT, and GPU threads all instantiate TLP.
optionExplanations.D: Wrong: modern architectures combine all three simultaneously.

assumptions: Comparison of general-purpose parallel architectures (CPU OoO cores, GPUs).
nonImplications: Does not imply the amount of each is unlimited; each has architectural budgets (issue width, SIMD width, thread count).
Does not imply exploiting one form always benefits another; ILP can degrade TLP if per-thread resources rise.

distractorRationales.D: Falsely assumes mutual exclusion of parallelism forms.
